async def act(page):
    # Fill in the title for the new issue
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").fill("Plans for Webagent support in Hugging Face dataset next quarter?")
    # Fill in the description for the new issue
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Description").fill("Do you have any plans on supporting Webagent in the next quarter in Hugging Face dataset?")
    # Press Enter in the title field to potentially submit the form
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").press("Enter")
